I can't find a name for that contact. The only mention is in the Coastal cheat sheet. It says engineering provided a manual CSV patch for Driftmoor's night dispatcher on the Terminal B tide-table import failure, but it doesn't name the person.

The night dispatcher named in the notes is Hector, but he works at Pellucid Harbor Logistics (the Beaumont barge slip), not Driftmoor. I wouldn't assume they're the same person.

Kwame owns the Driftmoor account, so he's the best person to ask for the name and email. I don't have an address for anyone at Driftmoor, so I can't draft the note yet. Any mail to a Driftmoor address would also need Ruth Calloway's approval, because it goes outside pemberline.com.
